# Third-Party Provenance and Attribution

`DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.Mermaid` implements the Mermaid text language. The package is **derived with
attribution**: to draw diagrams the way Mermaid draws them, its preprocessing, diagram detection, parsers,
configuration defaults, themes and layout are ports of the projects listed below. Every ported item is acknowledged
here, the license texts of the upstream projects ship with the package (in its `licenses\` folder), and every source
file that contains ported logic starts with the header comment
`// Portions derived from <project> (<license>); see third-party/README.md`. Ported code is local source code, maintained
and tested in this repository; no upstream package is a dependency.

This project is **not affiliated with, and is not endorsed or promoted by**, the Mermaid project, its authors or the
authors of @mermaid-js/parser, Langium, dayjs, js-yaml, khroma, dagre, graphlib, dagre-d3-es, lodash, marked, d3, sanitize-url, cytoscape, cytoscape-cose-bilkent, cose-base or layout-base. The names are used only to describe the language that is implemented.

## Original work

The public API, the location map, the scene model and painter (`Scenegraph/`), the picture loading of `NodeImages`
(`Rendering/`), the named character references of `HtmlEntities` (`Syntax/`, the 252 references of the HTML 4
specification and five HTML 5 names), the CSS declaration subset of
`StyleDeclarations` (`Configuration/`), the HTML clean-up of `HtmlSanitizer` (`Syntax/`, which reproduces the
results of DOMPurify, the sanitizer Mermaid uses, for the inline HTML of labels; the element and attribute names it
allows are the standard HTML names that DOMPurify allows by default), the resource limits other than
`maxTextSize` and `maxEdges`, the diagnostics, hints and codes, and the tests are original work of this repository.
The test fixtures are original diagrams. The upstream vectors under `Fixtures/upstream-vectors/` of the tests
are generated from the pinned mermaid and khroma by `tools/visual-diff/mermaid/gen-theme-vectors.mjs` and
`gen-flowchart-vectors.mjs` (whose flowchart texts in `flowchart-vector-cases.mjs` are original),
`gen-sequence-vectors.mjs` (whose sequence texts in `sequence-vector-cases.mjs` are original) and
`gen-shape-vectors.mjs` (single nodes of every shape and label kind, measured in headless Chrome with the bundled
Liberation Sans) and `gen-curve-vectors.mjs` (point sets drawn by d3-shape's line generator with every edge curve) and
`gen-time-vectors.mjs` (`time-axis.json`: dates, intervals, domains and format specifiers computed by the d3 time
packages that mermaid bundles, run in Node with the time zone UTC);
their inputs are original, and their expected values are the results of those MIT-licensed projects. The class
vectors (`class-parser.json`) are generated by `gen-diagram-vectors.mjs --type class`; most of their texts in
`class-vector-cases.mjs` are the inputs of mermaid's own class parser tests (`classDiagram.spec.ts`,
`classDiagram-styles.spec.js`, `classTypes.spec.ts` and `parser/class.spec.js` of mermaid 11.17.2, MIT, same copyright
notice as `LICENSE-mermaid.txt`), each named in its case's `spec` field; the others are original texts and the class
fixtures, and the expected values are mermaid's results. The state and ER vectors (`state-parser.json` and
`er-parser.json`) are generated the same way by `gen-diagram-vectors.mjs --type state` and `--type er`; most of their
texts in `state-vector-cases.mjs` and `er-vector-cases.mjs` are the inputs of mermaid's own state and ER parser tests
(`stateDiagram-v2.spec.js`, `stateDiagram.spec.js`, `parser/state-parser.spec.js`, `parser/state-style.spec.js`,
`parser/erDiagram.spec.js` and `parser/subgraph.spec.js` of mermaid 11.17.2, MIT, same copyright notice as
`LICENSE-mermaid.txt`), each named in its case's `spec` field; the others are original texts (some modeled on
`stateDb.spec.js` and `erDb.spec.js`, which call the databases directly) and the state and ER fixtures, and the
expected values are mermaid's results. The pie vectors (`pie-parser.json`) are generated the same way by
`gen-diagram-vectors.mjs --type pie`; many of their texts in `pie-vector-cases.mjs` are the inputs of mermaid's pie spec
(`diagrams/pie/pie.spec.ts` of mermaid 11.17.2, MIT, same copyright notice as `LICENSE-mermaid.txt`) and of the pie tests
of @mermaid-js/parser (`tests/pie.test.ts` of the parser 1.2.1, MIT, the notice of `LICENSE-mermaid-parser.txt`), each named
in its case's `spec` field; the others are original texts and the pie fixtures. The gantt vectors (`gantt-parser.json`)
are generated by `gen-diagram-vectors.mjs --type gantt` in pages whose time zone is UTC and whose clock is fixed; many
of their texts in `gantt-vector-cases.mjs` are the inputs of mermaid's gantt specs (`diagrams/gantt/parser/gantt.spec.js`
and `diagrams/gantt/ganttDb.spec.ts` of mermaid 11.17.2, MIT, same copyright notice as `LICENSE-mermaid.txt`; the
database calls of the latter written as gantt texts), each named in its case's `spec` field; the others are original
texts and the gantt fixtures. The mindmap vectors (`mindmap-parser.json`) are generated by
`gen-diagram-vectors.mjs --type mindmap`; many of their texts in `mindmap-vector-cases.mjs` are the inputs of mermaid's mindmap
specs (`diagrams/mindmap/mindmap.spec.ts` and `diagrams/mindmap/mindmapDb.getData.test.ts` of mermaid 11.17.2, MIT, same
copyright notice as `LICENSE-mermaid.txt`; the database calls of the latter written as mindmap texts), each named in
its case's `spec` field; the others are original texts and the mindmap fixtures. The packet vectors
(`packet-parser.json`) are generated by `gen-diagram-vectors.mjs --type packet`; many of their texts in
`packet-vector-cases.mjs` are the inputs of mermaid's packet spec (`diagrams/packet/packet.spec.ts` of mermaid 11.17.2,
MIT, same copyright notice as `LICENSE-mermaid.txt`) and of the packet tests of @mermaid-js/parser
(`tests/packet.test.ts` of the parser 1.2.1, MIT, the notice of `LICENSE-mermaid-parser.txt`), each named in its case's
`spec` field; the others are original texts and the packet fixtures. The git graph vectors (`gitgraph-parser.json`) are
generated by `gen-diagram-vectors.mjs --type gitgraph` in pages whose `Math.random` is the mulberry32 sequence of
`tools/visual-diff/mermaid/seeded-random.mjs` (original), so that the commit ids mermaid generates are those
CanvasNet generates; many of their texts in `gitgraph-vector-cases.mjs` are the inputs of mermaid's git graph spec
(`diagrams/git/gitGraph.spec.ts` of mermaid 11.17.2, MIT, same copyright notice as `LICENSE-mermaid.txt`) and of the
git graph tests of @mermaid-js/parser (`tests/gitGraph.test.ts` of the parser 1.2.1, MIT, the notice of
`LICENSE-mermaid-parser.txt`), each named in its case's `spec` field; the others are original texts and the git graph
fixtures. The dagre stage
goldens (`dagre-layouts.json`) are generated from dagre-d3-es by `tools/visual-diff/mermaid/gen-dagre-goldens.mjs`
on graphs from a seeded generator, so their inputs are original too. The dagre unit tests under `Dagre/` include cases
ported from the test files of dagre-d3-es (`*.test.js`, MIT, same copyright notices as `LICENSE-dagre.txt`). The link check tests of `UrlSanitizer` (`Syntax/`) include the inputs of the test file of sanitize-url 7.1.2 (`src/__tests__/index.test.ts`, MIT, same copyright notice as `LICENSE-sanitize-url.txt`), with expected values that are its results. The
JavaScript key order of `ObjectKeyMap` (`Graphlib/`) follows the ECMAScript specification, and the work budget of
`LayoutWorkMeter` (`Dagre/`) is original. The correctly rounded sine, cosine, logarithm and power of `CoseLayout`
(`Cose/CoseLayout.Math.cs`) are original work. The cose layout goldens (`cose-layouts.json`) and the math vectors
(`js-math.json`) are generated by `tools/visual-diff/mermaid/gen-cose-goldens.mjs`, which runs the libraries bundled by
mermaid 11.17.2 in headless Chrome on trees from a seeded generator and on three original mindmaps; their inputs are
original, and their expected values are the results of those MIT-licensed projects and of Chrome's `Math`.
